title: Generate RP2040 instruments from a protected USB production contract
problem: A nominal RP2040 board can omit external flash, USB protection, regulator limits, debug access, or purposeful enclosure geometry.
rootCause: MCU selection was not coupled to required support circuits and mechanical access.
solution: Use a 5V USB-powered four-layer RP2040 instrument template with exact flash, ESD, regulator, connector, CC, decoupling and SWD requirements plus an enclosure-matched rounded outline.
limitations: Measurement input range and analog accuracy require product-specific requirements.
USB compliance and EMC remain validation gates.
